body:
One Equity Partners has agreed to acquire technology distribution business Nexora from DCC for $725m, according to Reuters, as the Irish group continues restructuring ahead of KKR’s planned acquisition of DCC Energy. Nexora generates about £2.5bn in annual revenue and £79.8m in operating profit, with 2,500 employees across North America and Europe. The transaction gives One Equity Partners a new investment in technology distribution while allowing DCC to concentrate on the remaining businesses involved in its strategic restructuring.

KKR and TotalEnergies have agreed to expand their US renewable energy joint venture with the addition of three utility-scale solar projects in Texas and Ohio, representing an enterprise value of $1.2bn. The 700 MW portfolio will increase the 50/50 venture’s capacity from 1.4 GW to 2.1 GW, with the new assets expected to begin commercial operations by the first quarter of 2027. TotalEnergies will continue operating the projects following completion, expected later this year.

TA Associates has agreed to sell Canadian engineering software specialist Rocscience to Swedish industrial technology group Hexagon at an enterprise value of about $535m. TA will fully exit the business, which develops software used to model the behaviour of rock, soil and structures in mining and infrastructure engineering. Rocscience will join Hexagon’s Infrastructure & Geospatial business, combining its modelling technology with the buyer’s radar monitoring capabilities. Completion is expected in the fourth quarter of 2026. Lazard advised TA on the sale, with Kirkland & Ellis providing legal counsel.

Sopris Capital has acquired medical imaging AI specialist Blackford Analysis from Bayer and plans to combine it with portfolio company Azra AI. Scotland-based Blackford provides a platform integrating more than 130 medical imaging AI applications from over 45 vendors, while Azra develops technology for identifying and managing cancer patients. Blackford will remain a separate legal entity following the combination, retaining its operations in Scotland and the US. Bayer acquired Blackford in 2023.
